newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh and Iran have decided to sign a shipping agreement to boost bilateral trade.
Syed Manzur Elahi, a leading entrepreneur and a former adviser to the caretaker government, has regretted the offer of the post of the chairman of the Privatisation Board.
Prince Charles of Britain arrives in Dhaka on Wednesday on a three-day visit to Bangladerh.
The government will soon announce a fresh education policy, focussing on technology, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Tuesday.
The World Bank has suggested the government to give top priority to import liberalisation, bringing down the highest tariff rate within 20 percent.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina told the parliament on Tuesday that the recently held microcredit summit in Washington has institutionlised the concept of small loans.

The Securities and Exhange Commission (SEC) was pursuing the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) to diversify its council with equal representations from all interest groups, said SEC Chairman Harun-Ur Rashid on Tuesday.
The country's present food stock stand at 0.77 million tonnes, said Food Minister Begum Matia Chowdhury on Tuesday.
